(a) Repeal and Rescission.--Section 50142 of Public Law 117-169 (136 Stat. 2044) (commonly known as the ``Inflation Reduction Act of 2022'') is repealed and the unobligated balance of amounts made available under that section (as in effect on the day before the date of enactment of this Act) is rescinded. (b) Rescissions.-- (1) In general.--The unobligated balances of amounts made available under the sections described in paragraph (2) are rescinded. (2) Sections described.--The sections referred to in paragraph (1) are the following sections of Public Law 117-169 (commonly known as the ``Inflation Reduction Act of 2022''): (A) Section 50123 (42 U.S.C. 18795b). (B) Section 50141 (136 Stat. 2042). (C) Section 50144 (136 Stat. 2044). (D) Section 50145 (136 Stat. 2045). (E) Section 50151 (42 U.S.C. 18715). (F) Section 50152 (42 U.S.C. 18715a). (G) Section 50153 (42 U.S.C. 18715b). (H) Section 50161 (42 U.S.C. 17113b). SEC. 50403. ENERGY DOMINANCE FINANCING. (a) In General.--Section 1706 of the Energy Policy Act of 2005 (42 U.S.C. 16517) is amended-- (1) in subsection (a)-- (A) in paragraph (1), by striking ``or'' at the end; [[Page 139 STAT. 153]] (B) in paragraph (2), by striking ``avoid'' and all that follows through the period at the end and inserting ``increase capacity or output; or''; and (C) by adding at the end the following: ``(3) support or enable the provision of known or forecastable electric supply at time intervals necessary to maintain or enhance grid reliability or other system adequacy needs.''; (2) by striking subsection (c); (3) by redesignating subsections (d) through (f) as subsections (c) through (e), respectively; (4) in subsection (c) (as so redesignated)-- (A) in paragraph (1), by adding ``and'' at the end; (B) by striking paragraph (2); and (C) by redesignating paragraph (3) as paragraph (2); (5) in subsection (e) (as so redesignated), by striking ``for--'' in the matter preceding paragraph (1) and all that follows through the period at the end of paragraph (2) and inserting ``for enabling the identification, leasing, development, production, processing, transportation, transmission, refining, and generation needed for energy and critical minerals.''; and (6) by adding at the end the following: ``(f) Funding.-- ``(1) <<NOTE: Time period. Expiration date.>> In general.-- In addition to amounts otherwise available, there is appropriated to the Secretary for fiscal year 2025, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, $1,000,000,000, to remain available through September 30, 2028, to carry out activities under this section. ``(2) Administrative costs.--Of the amount made available under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall use not more than 3 percent for administrative expenses.''. (b) Commitment Authority.--Section 50144(b) of Public Law 117-169 (commonly known as the ``Inflation Reduction Act of 2022'') (136 Stat. 2045) is amended by striking ``2026'' and inserting ``2028''.

new_rationale:
Complete own Perry No.27 and the reported Title17 heading retain distinct funding mechanisms. The instruction reduces the printed general-fund administrative appropriation by35million and adds35million to the SpendingReductionAccount. The heading separately permits up to35million FY2026fee collections for administration through September30,2027, limits excess collections to future advance appropriations, reduces general-fund amounts as current/prior fees are received with an already estimated final general-fund appropriation of0, and separately appropriates150million for reactor loan-guarantee COSTS, not loan principal. It preserves detailed Federal-support exceptions and advance written OMB certification. These clauses do not establish a35million net Treasury saving, elimination of every administrative resource, a negative appropriation, or cancellation of the separate150million.
The seven complete retained2024Code units16511–16517 are now linked as DATED program context, not a current conformed-law certificate. They distinguish credit-reform guarantee cost from project/loan amounts, general80percent project-cost guarantee limits from subsidy cost, repayment/prospect/non-subordination and borrower-payment predicates, Treasury analysis, records/audits, fee collection after financial close, and fee availability subject to annual appropriation conditions. Ordinary16512(f) uses the lesser of30years or90percent of asset life; the separately printed16517term override is not collapsed into that ordinary rule. The two printed(r)subsections remain distinct. Eligible-project categories are broad and conditional, not nuclear-only or automatic eligibility; no actual application, certification, political influence, benefit, loan, fee receipt or deployment is inferred.
The2024section16517text is HISTORICAL relative to the already bound July2025PublicLaw119-21sections50402–50403. The later law rescinds specified UNOBLIGATED balances, amends1706to include operating infrastructure capacity/output and grid reliability/system adequacy, removes the former fossil-generation control requirement and community-effect application analysis, changes the energy-infrastructure definition, and provides an additional1billion throughSeptember30,2028with NOT MORE THAN3percent for administration. Those later changes are not silently replaced by the older Code text. The bill’s35million administrative-line amendment does not itself repeal that later section or prove its funds/administrative allocation are exhausted. The printed2007section16515four-billion commitment figure is NOT certified as the current aggregate limit;16516is omitted after expiration and is not revived. Authorization amounts are not actual appropriations, and unobligated-balance rescission is not cancellation of all prior obligations or all program authority.
Complete credit-reform and10CFR609.2/609.8definitions, other applicable appropriations/balances and intervening/current integrated law remain unbound. The legal availability/interaction of unchanged fee-credit/use provisos after reducing the general-fund line, whole fiscal effect and whole technology-finance versus administrative-budget membership remain pending before a shared action meaning. No guess resolves those qualifications. Recorded120–306rejection is not enactment or realized savings; all domain membership remains unaccepted.
